tool.name: CSV/XLSX to FASTA
tool.description: build FASTA sequence files from spreadsheets or tables

param.name: name_column
param.label: Name column
param.help: Use a header name, a 1-based column number, or an Excel column letter. Leave this blank to auto-generate 1, 2, 3... names.

param.name: sequence_column
param.label: Sequence column
param.help: Use a header name, a 1-based column number, or an Excel column letter.

tool.help:
This tool converts a simple sequence table into a FASTA file.
Supported inputs ================
- ``csv`` - ``xlsx`` - delimiter-separated text tables that Galaxy identifies as ``tabular`` or ``txt``
Column selection ================
For both the **Name column** and **Sequence column** parameters, you can use:
- the column header name such as ``name`` or ``sequence`` - a 1-based column number such as ``1`` or ``2`` - an Excel-style column letter such as ``A`` or ``B``
By default the tool looks for columns named ``name`` and ``sequence``.
Automatic names ===============
If the input only has a sequence column, or if you leave **Name column** blank, the tool automatically generates FASTA identifiers ``1``, ``2``, ``3`` ... in output order.
